ns2:course.label: Economic Structure of Comm
ns2:course.description: (COMM 264) Describes and analyzes the economic structures, policies, and current problems of fields such as telecommunications, publishing, broadcasting and cable, film, recorded music, and postal service; examines how copyrights, patents, antitrust laws, and government regulation bear on the communications industry.
